Main Courses: Chili con carne (tortilla chips, cheddar and Isigny crème fraîche, red onion, coriander, white rice and kidney beans), Free-range chicken glazed with barbecue sauce and spices (herb polenta, mixed mushrooms, seasonal vegetables and poultry jus with cranberries), Mac & Cheddar Cheese (pasta, smoked cheddar cheese sauce, pastrami and crispy onions), Pan-seared sea bass fillet (black Venere rice risotto with broad beans and peas, braised red cabbage and apples with cider vinegar, Espelette pepper red pepper coulis, polenta crisps) or Stuffed cabbage with marinated pea-soy-sunflower protein shredded filling (vegan; mashed potato and sweet potato duo, sautéed mushrooms and barbecue sauce). Desserts: Lemon Meringue Tart, Pineapple Upside-Down Cake and vanilla-infused Isigny crème fraîche with mascarpone, Flower Street Sundae, Chocolate sweet-potato brookie (vegan; with peanuts and hazelnuts, peanut butter crémeux, cookie ice cream and caramelised almonds) or Mascarpone mille-feuille with praline and caramelised almonds

items.description: For children ages 3 to 11. Starter, Main Course, Dessert and Drink. Seasonal vegetable velouté, carrot cake (Kiri® cream, beetroot, beetroot and carrot juices, fried onions) or soy pancake with vegetables (avocado crémeux and quail egg, cocktail sauce); chicken supreme (carrot purée, chicken jus with barbecue sauce), smoked cheddar mac & cheese (crispy onion) or pan-seared sea bass (potato mousseline, courgette and carrot pearls, red pepper coulis); almond milk smoothie with seasonal fruits, vanilla ice-cream and strawberry sorbet sundae (vanilla Isigny cream and seasonal fruits) or passion fruit, milk chocolate and coconut biscuit entremet dessert with mango coulis; Vittel® 33 cl, orange juice, apple juice 25 cl or milk 20 cl. Or Disney Check Menu: velouté, chicken supreme with carrot purée and chicken jus with barbecue sauce, almond milk smoothie with seasonal fruits, Vittel® 33 cl. A different cold drink (25 cl) may replace similar item on request
